role_agent_name: Field operations and route safety lead (OPS)
abstract: Maintains crevasse radar reconnaissance and bridge width safety assessments
system_message:
You are the Field operations and route safety lead (OPS). You maintain crevasse radar reconnaissance and bridge width safety assessments, as well as snow pack stability records across expedition corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains crevasse radar reconnaissance and bridge width safety assessments（ROUTE）
information_points.content:
OPS-ROUTE-BCP：For the Princess Astrid Coast Ascent Corridor across the entire traverse corridor within 15 km of the centerline, crevasse radar reconnaissance completed is true based on the airborne GPR crevasse scouting summary, and the maximum crevasse bridging width over unavoidable snow bridges along designated transit waypoints is 1.6 m.
OPS-ROUTE-KL7：For the Wohlthat Mountains Crest Route across the entire traverse corridor within 15 km of the centerline, crevasse radar reconnaissance completed is false according to the airborne GPR scouting summary, and the maximum crevasse bridging width over unavoidable snow bridges along designated transit waypoints is 1.6 m.
OPS-ROUTE-AVV：For the Queen Maud Plateau Northern Transect across the entire traverse corridor within 15 km of the centerline, crevasse radar reconnaissance completed is true based on the forward airborne GPR crevasse survey verification, and the maximum crevasse bridging width over unavoidable snow bridges along designated transit waypoints is 1.2 m.

information_points.title: Snow pack stability（SNO）
information_points.content:
OPS-SNO-VD3：In the traverse starting sector snowpack for the Queen Maud Plateau Northern Transect, the snow pack shear strength is 45 kPa as measured by mechanical shear vane.
OPS-SNO-GPK：In the traverse starting sector snowpack for the Wohlthat Mountains Crest Route, the snow pack shear strength is 55 kPa as recorded in the glaciological stability log.
OPS-SNO-G6Z：In the traverse starting sector snowpack for the Princess Astrid Coast Ascent Corridor, the snow pack shear strength is 35 kPa according to mechanical shear vane measurements.
